name: Rohan Nooniwal
intro:
Hello! I'm Rohan and you're currently exploring my tiny corner of the internet. I use this space to share the products I build and the engineering I'm obsessed with.

I'm a Full Stack Developer at CARE Health Insurance and a final-year Computer Science student at IIIT Kota. Day to day I work on scalable web apps, secure APIs, and cloud-backed systems with React, Node.js, Go, MongoDB, PostgreSQL, Docker, Redis, and AWS.

Outside work I build full-stack products, explore AI/ML (LLMs, sentiment analysis, CNNs, RNNs, LSTMs), and sharpen problem-solving through 350+ DSA challenges across LeetCode, GeeksforGeeks, and Codeforces.
